summary: Frontend-only regression and redesign test (fourth visual pass, ChatFrame-inspired) of DataKat /login and /app in preview mode. 9 Playwright runs against the public URL; every requested check passed. REGRESSION: the auth gate redirects /app to /login. Login 401 ('Invalid email or password.'), 429 (submit disabled) and network ('We couldn't reach DataKat. Try again.') pass. Canonical success shows Charlie 580 / 0.10, 3 customers, '3 rows returned', Export disabled with 'Not available yet'. All 22 other 'Next question response' scenarios render the expected card and title (success x8, clarification x2, unsupported x2, domainError, compat x5 incl. session-mismatch, invalid 422, unavailable 500, network, forbidden 403). Clarification: clicking an interpretation fills the composer without sending, shows the 'In draft' badge and the label 'Clarification'; the replace dialog cancel keeps the user's edit and confirm replaces it. Edit question (zero-row and unsupported cards) and Review and retry fill the composer without sending. 401 restores the draft with the restore notice for the same email only; a different email gets an empty composer. 403-source-removed shows 'This data source is no longer available.', the header shows 'Not available' and the composer is disabled. 429 counts down ('You can send again in 19 seconds.' then 16) with no auto-send, the draft is kept and Send is re-enabled. Long wait shows the 15s and 45s messages, the draft typed while pending is kept, and Send and rail New analysis are disabled while pending. The inactivity notice appears and Send stays enabled. New analysis cancel/confirm works on the rail and on mobile. Shift+Enter makes a newline; a whitespace-only draft and 8001 characters (limit message + counter) disable Send, and 8000 is allowed. Sign-out failure shows its message; success goes to /login. Data-source states none/multiple/failure/long-name/single are correct, with no topology strings. No SQL strings are in the DOM in any fixture. CAT REMOVAL: 0 .dk-face/.dk-cat/svg.dk-face on login, empty, pending, result, removed-source and at all 8 viewports, and no cat code remains in src. The wordmark img alt='DataKat' (/brand/datakat-logo.png, naturalWidth 800) is visible in the desktop header, the mobile header and on login. Palette: body #03060C, chrome #070B12, plane #0B111B, text #D1DCEC. COMPOSER: the resting shell is 72px (1440x900, 1366x768) and 70px (390x844). With 13 lines the textarea caps at 208px (scrollHeight 332 > clientHeight 208) and the shell is 236px. Deleting back to one line returns it to the resting height. Send is 44x44 with aria-label 'Send', and the textarea's right edge stays 8px left of Send at every size. Focus-within changes the border from rgba(174,193,220,0.12) to rgba(134,184,255,0.62). LOGIN CENTRING: the wordmark, h1, subtitle and form centres match exactly (0px difference) at all 8 viewports; labels are text-align start (left). RESPONSIVE: scrollWidth equals innerWidth with success-20-columns at 1920, 1440, 1366, 1024, 768, 390, 360 and 320. The rail shows at >=768 and is hidden below. At 1280x420 the page scrolls (scrollHeight 479) and the composer is reachable and typeable. A11Y: Skip to workspace is the first tab stop and moves focus to MAIN. Buttons, Send, interpretation buttons and the preview trigger get a 2px #86B8FF outline. Status messages are 'Question sent.' and 'Result ready. 3 rows returned.' getAnimations() is [] under reduced motion at login, app, pending and result (result opacity 1). Note: with motion on there are also no running animations while pending (the old dk-eye-glow was removed with the cat), which is expected.
critical_code_review_comments: datakat.css line 189 still has an orphan '/* Cat motif */' comment with no rules under it; remove it as cleanup.
QuestionComposer.jsx: the nested .dk-composer-shell/.dk-composer-box wrappers are mis-indented (cosmetic only).
test_credentials: Preview mode: analyst@example.com / secret (any email/password works); /app/memory/test_credentials.md is present and matches.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview sign-in is in memory, so log in again after page.goto. Avoid [class*=cat] selectors because 'dk-source-indicator' contains 'cat'; use .dk-face, .dk-cat and svg.dk-face. Edit question exists only on zero-row success and unsupported cards (by design), not on the canonical success. The composer textarea itself has outline none; the focus indicator is the .dk-composer-box border on focus-within. To check that Skip is the first tab stop, focus the body first: a mouse click into the plane changes the tab start. The 403-source-removed notice needs about 4s of waiting.
